text: Did you know, if you cook blueberries
and add a splash of water, then smash them up,
squeeze in a lemon and add three tablespoons of chia seeds.
Let the chia sit in the mixture for 20 minutes.
It swells up and thickens the whole thing into a jam.
You don't even need to add sweetener.
This is the healthiest jam you'll ever eat.
Put it on some sourdough toast.
I eat this just pretty much every day.
If you want more simple recipes like this, comment yes
and follow me so you don't miss the next one.
